## Welcome!

My name is **Yevgen Ryeznik** <br/>(*Ukrainian🇺🇦: Євген Рєзнік*).

I am a *Quantitative Scientist* with 20+ years of working experience in academia & industry. I enjoy solving applied complex problems with mathematical and statistical modeling & simulation, using Julia, R, Python, and MatLab.

In 2019, I obtained a PhD degree in *applied mathematics and statistics* at [*Uppsala University*](https://uu.se/) (Sweden). The PhD project was a part of the [*Center for Interdisciplinary Mathematics* (CIM)](https://www.math.uu.se/research/cim/) initiative. My supervisors were professor [*Warwick Tucker*](https://katalog.uu.se/profile/?id=XX4412) from the [*Department of Mathematics*](https://math.uu.se/) and professor [*Andrew Hooker*](https://katalog.uu.se/profile/?id=N4-631) from the [*Department of Pharmacy, Pharmacometrics Research Group*](https://katalog.uu.se/organisation/?orgId=FF3:12).

My detailed CV is available [**here**](./cv.html).

[Here](./teaching.html), you can find information about several courses, that I teach/taught.
